$comment: Tavus Objectives: the milestones a call must reach, in order. Tavus keeps steering the PAL toward whichever objective is active, so only milestones the caller is already driving belong here; questions they might skip (their situation, their priorities, the Medicaid note) live in the system prompt, where they're asked once and dropped. Earlier versions had them here and Anna repeated them every turn (seen in the evals).

objectives.objective_prompt: The caller says whether they're okay with the conversation being transcribed. If they decline, thank them, tell them they can call Harbor to speak with a licensed advisor directly, and end the call.

Learn which doctors the caller wants to keep and which medications they take, checking each one with the lookup tools. This is complete once they've named them, said they have none, or moved on to plans or booking.
The caller either books a call with a licensed Harbor advisor at a specific time, or says they only want information for now.
